GROUPS AND OPERATOR ALGEBRAS: FINAL CURRENT STATUS

Strongest target: torsion-free WORD-HYPERBOLIC group whose F2 group ring is not directly finite.
New direct lemma: from source197's fixed nearly-fully-paired bounded-system exclusion, fixed-boundary cone diagrams satisfy H<64|w|/epsilon. The SAME (K0,C,I) as source sphere extraction suffices, with no new outer graph lift or changed quantifier. Maximal-tree cycle relators convert H to ordinary finite Dehn area, hence hyperbolicity. Independently audited geometry, surgery, and Dehn conversion found no remaining lemma gap. Combining with source197 scalar parity and torsion/root construction yields the conditional target. The complete released bounded-pattern/random/topology theorem is still a source dependency, not externally validated here.

Acquisition improvement: bounded-system exclusion is finite and decidable. Rationalized constants and an exhaustive finite search over matching graphs provide a terminating presentation/witness compiler conditional on the source probability estimate. No asymptotic threshold oracle is needed. Source acquisition and exponential/factorial enumeration costs remain astronomical; no actual admissible graph/presentation or scalar witnesses were emitted in this run.

Exact module consequence: e=1-ba is a nonzero idempotent and P=eR a nonzero projective right module with P⊕R≅R. This is an explicit rank-zero stably free summand and [P]=0. It remains compatible with K0(R)=Z; Grothendieck group information alone cannot impose projective cancellation.

Primary proof and cost/provenance ledger: hyperbolic_direct_finiteness_candidate.txt. Independent geometry audits: hyperbolicity_adversary/AUDIT.md, hyperbolicity_adversary/dehn_conversion/AUDIT.md. Quantitative source audits: patterns_fault/PATTERNS_AUDIT.txt and its random_audit/AUDIT.txt, embedding_audit/AUDIT.txt. These audits found no exact proof fault in their scopes; 132,848 finite systems are a diagnostic only. All seven source197 sections byte-match pinned commit adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a; source_snapshot.txt preserves hashes.

IMPORTANT WITHDRAWN OBJECTION: an earlier report inferred established positive-characteristic FJ/idempotent incompatibility from BLR intro statements. Exact sibling primary tracing invalidated that inference. General FJ companion theorem requires stable finiteness or soficity; Formanek1973
